description: This file defines a composable Kotlin function for a dashboard UI screen in an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It contains UI elements such as connection status, points count, and a mock generator toggle, built using AndroidView to embed traditional Android views.

methods.name: DashboardScreen
methods.description: A composable function that displays a dashboard with connection status, points count, and a toggle for mock generator. It uses AndroidView to build and update the view hierarchy.
